reason: I'd happily pay someone to sort it all, but a company in Kuwait with no UK clients to show me, asking for half up front, is a punt I'm not taking. And I'm not letting an AI talk to my customers when I can't pop round and shout at someone if it books them wrong.
objection: No past clients and no UK presence. If it goes wrong, or the AI tells a customer something daft, who do I actually chase? I've already had three web designers DM me this month and they all say the same nice things.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing two or three real Manchester businesses they've done, that I can ring and ask, plus paying less up front so I'm not risking half before I've seen anything.
